summary: Pulse Biosciences filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that its NANOPULSE-AF IDE pivotal clinical study reached its enrollment target of 164 evaluable patients across 15 U.S. clinical sites, with first patients treated in April 2026. The prospective, multicenter, non-randomized study evaluates the nPulse Cardiac Catheter System for drug-resistant, symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, with primary safety and effectiveness endpoints assessed at 6 and 12 months post-ablation. This is a routine clinical/operational update with an attached press release, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply.
